item.title: There's a trade developing in energy stocks you should 'attack' now, says Jay Woods
item.description: As brent crude drops below $90 and energy stocks pull back, there's a trade developing in the space that you should "attack right now," says investor Jay Woods.

item.title: Anthropic officially sets the stage for an IPO valuing the company north of $1 trillion
item.description: Anthropic could raise up to $63 billion in an IPO expected to take place next week.
